test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: There is a rectangular field of dimensions 100 m and 80 m respectively. If a path of uniform width 10 m runs around and inside it. then the area of path will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of the rectangular field: 100 m and 80 m

Width of the path: 10 m

**Formula Used:**

Area of path = Area of outer rectangle - Area of inner rectangle

**Calculation:**

Dimensions of the inner rectangle

Length = 100 - 2×10 = 80 m

Breadth = 80 - 2×10 = 60 m

Area of the inner rectangle = 80 m × 60 m

Area of the inner rectangle = 4800 m²

Area of the outer rectangle (original field) = 100 m × 80 m

Area of the outer rectangle = 8000 m²

Area of the path = Area of outer rectangle - Area of inner rectangle

⇒ Area of the path = 8000 m² - 4800 m²

⇒ Area of the path = 3200 m²

**The area of the path is 3200 m².**
